note: Prototype decisions for Screen 03 (Book Step Three: Upbringing, Core pp.117-119). The book's d20 roll is not offered; the player chooses. Captain's Log's Aspiration and Caste approaches are not used, so there is one list of Upbringings with Accepted / Rebelled. The focus can be one of the Upbringing's book examples, any of the book's Sample Focuses (pp.94-95), or the player's own (the book: the focus 'should relate in some way to the Upbringing chosen (a few examples are provided in each case)'). The talent uses the existing Early Outlook talent slot.
